title: Pixel clock
description: A pixel digital clock showing the current time as HH:MM:SS that updates every second, a 12/24-hour toggle, and a stopwatch-style lap of how long the page has been open.

title: Fuel cost calculator
description: A pixel trip fuel calculator: distance in km, consumption in litres per 100 km and price per litre, show the litres needed and the total cost to two decimals, and a Reset button.

title: FAQ accordion
description: A pixel FAQ page with 5 questions: clicking a question expands its answer and collapses any other open one, an arrow shows the open state, and Expand all / Collapse all buttons.

title: Color mixer
description: A pixel RGB color mixer: three sliders from 0 to 255 for red, green and blue, a large preview swatch in that color, its hex code, and a Random button.

title: Hangman
description: A pixel hangman game with a built-in list of words: letter buttons A to Z, reveal guessed letters, count wrong guesses up to 6 with a drawing that grows, and win or lose messages with New game.

title: Reading tracker
description: A pixel reading tracker: add a book with a title and page count, log pages read for a book, show a progress bar and percent for each book, and mark it finished at 100%.

title: Tabbed notes
description: A pixel notes app with 3 tabs (Work, Home, Ideas): each tab has its own text area whose content is kept when switching tabs, the active tab is highlighted, and a character count per tab.

title: Dice race
description: A pixel two-player dice race to 20: players take turns rolling one die, positions advance on a track of 20 squares, show whose turn it is, and announce the winner with a Play again button.
